questions.question:
After arranging the given words according to dictionary order, which word will come at 'Fourth' position?

1. Slur

2. Suit

3. Slug

4. Slung

5. Slump
questions.solution:
The correct Dictionary order is:

3. Slu__**g**__

5. Slu__m__p

4. Slu__**n**__g

1. Slu__**r**__

2. Sui__**t**__

So, the word '**Slur**' will come at 'Fourth' position.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). C is not an immediate neighbour of D and A. B is sitting second to the left of E. A is sitting second to the right of E. Who is sitting on the immediate right of D?
questions.solution:
Given: Five persons A, B, C, D and E.

1) C is not an immediate neighbour of D and A.

2) B is sitting second to the left of E.

3) A is sitting second to the right of E. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fafabb31416d0353cd84c32a1af1d0e877a328e2bc25806c62520709096386ea.png] 

So, **A** is sitting on the immediate right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"A".**

questions.question: Eight athletes Sunil, Abhishek, Mohit, Cheenu, Rahul, Tanu, Koyal and Ankit are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Koyal is third to the left of Rahul. Tanu is third to the right of Cheenu. Mohit is second to the right of Sunil. Abhishek is second to the left of Cheenu. Tanu is second to the left of Sunil. Who is sitting second to the right of Ankit?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight athletes Sunil, Abhishek, Mohit, Cheenu, Rahul, Tanu, Koyal and Ankit.

1) Koyal is third to the left of Rahul.

2) Tanu is third to the right of Cheenu.

3) Mohit is second to the right of Sunil.

4) Abhishek is second to the left of Cheenu.

5) Tanu is second to the left of Sunil.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d374b82e07f4c00d19ee79e9b16cb1c4f0d7fc9d96bef78f4ea690a23a43459.png] 

So, Rahul is sitting second to the right of Ankit.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Rahul".**

questions.question: If 30 A 10 B 30 C 10 = 37 and 45 A 15 B 18 C 9 = 58, then 64 A 34 B 50 C 5 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00eff12cbfb2743907200209a8bfbec6be037efa94b2adc91402b0ba7d64fc45.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: **A means +, B means -, C means ÷.**

30 A 10 B 30 C 10 = 37

30 + 10 - 30 ÷ 10 = 40 - 3 = 37

45 A 15 B 18 C 9 = 58,

45 + 15 - 18 ÷ 9 = 60 - 2 = 58

Then **64 A 34 B 50 C 5 = ?**

**64 + 34 - 50 ÷ 5 = 98 - 10 = 88**

Hence, the correct answer is** "88".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some T are S.

II. No R is S.

**Conclusions:**

I. No S is R.

II. No R is T.

III. No S is T.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows

questions.solution:
**Given Statements:**

I. Some T are S.

II. No R is S.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/422fa92c9683d3d937dbfaf0dcc31bdadd8cd1753f7c7b84f2438709fa65fc49.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No S is R. - **True **(Because, No R is S, So, No S is also R)

II. No R is T. - **False **(Because, there is no relation between R and T, So it can be possible only)

III. No S is T. - **False **(Because, Some T are S, so some S is T but No S can never be T)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**

questions.question:
'E × F' means 'E is the wife of F'

'E + F' means 'E is the brother of F'

'E ÷ F' means 'E is the husband of F'

'E - F' means 'E is the son of F'

How is P related to R in the expression 'P × Q + I - R ÷ S'?
questions.solution:
Family Chart: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cd8ae3409a7e80e7adb6a6adafb5ca1703115230729aa5a03a081d033c62e82.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ×
 ÷
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother 
 Wife
 Husband
 Son
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e97582a22a412db073c8a9eae1d19265df4ac618893c331d5b20a016c090745.png] 

Given: P × Q + I - R ÷ S

It means: P is the wife of Q, Q is the brother of I, I is the son of R and R is the husband of S.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a5ea3d0f4151fa1a5e8a2b333602479f16fd127f2786a47c050fe522a109c53.png] 

So, P is the '**Son's wife**' of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Wife's brother".
